name: io.github.swisspra/pursers
title: Pursers
description: Coordinate AI-agent work on a local-first, owner-controlled MCP board

packageArguments.name: --data-root
packageArguments.description: Private directory for the Central SQLite store and request-state keys

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_CENTRAL_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Loopback bind host used by the packaged runtime

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_CENTRAL_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Loopback bind port used by the packaged runtime

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_CENTRAL_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Private Central data directory; --data-dir/--data-root is the equivalent CLI input

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_CENTRAL_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated bare Host names accepted in addition to the bind host

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_CENTRAL_TLS_CERTFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional TLS certificate path; requires ONBOARD_CENTRAL_TLS_KEYFILE

environmentVariables.name: ONBOARD_CENTRAL_TLS_KEYFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional TLS private-key path; requires ONBOARD_CENTRAL_TLS_CERTFILE

environmentVariables.name: CENTRAL_ADMISSION
environmentVariables.description: Central admission policy; Pursers supports invite-only admission

environmentVariables.name: CENTRAL_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Central authentication mode; Pursers supports JWT authentication

environmentVariables.name: CENTRAL_JWKS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the issuer public JWKS used to verify seat credentials

environmentVariables.name: CENTRAL_JWT_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: MCP resource URL in audience and resource claims; defaults to the loopback bind URL

environmentVariables.name: CENTRAL_JWT_CLOCK_SKEW
environmentVariables.description: Allowed JWT clock skew in seconds

environmentVariables.name: CENTRAL_JWT_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Exact issuer URL in every accepted seat credential

environmentVariables.name: CENTRAL_PRINCIPAL_STREAM_CAP
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent event streams accepted per principal

environmentVariables.name: CENTRAL_REAPER_INTERVAL_S
environmentVariables.description: Interval in seconds between expired-lease reaper sweeps

environmentVariables.name: PURSERS_LEGACY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: String flag: use 1 to expose deprecated coordination tools; use 0 to keep them hidden

environmentVariables.name: STORE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Central storage backend; Pursers supports SQLite

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.releaseNote: At the beta.3 candidate, copy the b3 product and central versions from tools/release_versions.toml; tools/check_server_json.py fails until both fields match.
